content:
emma: Heads up — kicking off migration orders.schema_v3 in 10m. Adding order_status (nullable). Backfill will be async workers, pinning API to v2.3 for the window. @kai @jordan

deploybot: deploy started: migration orders.schema_v3. Canary group: svc-order-1..4. Strategy: online add column + concurrent index. ETA ~30m. Logs: https://deploys.redwood/example (canary)

kai: what's the expected exclusive lock time? add column nullable fine but any default/backfill could cause rewrites.
jordan: no default, backfill done by job. index will be built with CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY (but we run it from migration runner). Should be non-blocking but watch replica I/O.
sarah: please watch replica lag — last index add we saw spikes when page writes hit replicas. set replication alert at 2s.
tom: I'll pin backend to commit 3f2a9b until migration completes and update release notes.
deploybot: canary 1/4 passed, 2/4 started. canary logs: tail: "index build: 12%"

emma: running preflight checks: checksum diffs 0; starting backfill phase A (small shard sets).
deploybot: canary 3/4 FAILED — observed long exclusive lock on orders_shard_12 for ~75s. Rolling canary and pausing rollout.
kai: pause. who holds the lock? can we get pg_locks + pid stack?
jordan: quick dump shows trigger payment_notify_trigger firing on insert from payment svc, which is doing a synchronous write to audit table. That cascade is holding a seqscan lock during concurrent index step. surprise.
emma: ok aborting rollout. rollback plan: stop backfill workers, drop temp concurrent index if created, revert schema_version to v2, and unpin API when stable. @tom start rollback notes and notify support.
deploybot: rollback started for migration orders.schema_v3. Canary envs 1-3 reverted. status: in-progress. Logs: https://deploys.redwood/example/rollback
sarah: opening postmortem ticket P-1234 and linking replication traces. Immediate action: re-enable normal traffic and remove any canary routing. Oncall: @kai please verify replicas.
kai: checked replicas — replication lag peaked but back to <1s after stopping workers. No long-term drift. Will monitor for 2 hours.
tom: release notes updated: https://docs.redwood/releases/notes/1758004321. Added note about abort and planned retry after trigger fix. Also pinned the CLI version in the notes.
jordan: created a small patch to make that trigger async behind a feature flag and added a unit test to simulate heavy payment inserts.
emma: thanks. follow-ups: 1) test trigger patch in staging, 2) schedule migration for next quiet window Mon 03:00 UTC, 3) add a preflight that runs trigger simulation. Will coordinate with SRE on alert thresholds.

Thank you everyone, closing this thread for now.
